answer: An onyx oasis guards an agent economy with Jacobsthal stair-climbing: every new identity must climb onyx steps toward the zenith, and the staircase nearly doubles each time, so the first fake climbs 1 step, the second 1, the third 3, the tenth 341 and the twentieth 349,525, and twenty fakes together climb 699,050 steps. Bulk farming fails because one climber climbs one staircase and each step must be taken before the next appears, so no step can be climbed in parallel or bought; like a lone traveller crossing a desert oasis one dune at a time, with no shortcut to the zenith.
